app_info.subtitle: Discover creators and works
app_info.description: Publica Now helps people discover independent creators and publicly listed creative works. Search by title, creator, description, or content type, then inspect a creator's public profile and published-work metadata. The connector is public, read-only, and non-transactional.

justifications.read_only_justification: Queries existing public creator and work metadata without changing any record.
justifications.open_world_justification: Retrieves Publica Now catalog data without contacting third parties or changing external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, overwrite, publish, transact, message, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves one existing public creator profile and its public work metadata without changing data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads Publica Now public catalog records without contacting the creator or changing external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot alter creator profiles or works, publish content, transact, or perform an irreversible action.

test_cases.user_prompt: Find audiobooks published by independent creators on Publica Now.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns relevant public catalog metadata with titles, creators, content types, descriptions, and canonical Publica Now URLs.

test_cases.description: Search for a creator by name.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find public works by creator Ana Torres on Publica Now.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns matching public works and creator slugs when available, without inventing missing catalog records.

test_cases.description: Search by content type and topic.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me up to five publicly listed photography works about Lisbon.
test_cases.expected_output: Uses the photography content type and Lisbon query and returns at most five relevant public results.

test_cases.description: Retrieve a known public creator profile.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the public Publica Now creator profile for club-infok.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the creator's public profile and published-work metadata with canonical URLs.

test_cases.description: Handle a creator slug that does not exist.
test_cases.user_prompt: Look up the Publica Now creator slug no-such-creator-12345.
test_cases.expected_output: Clearly reports that no public creator has that slug and does not invent a profile.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the discovery connector for creator onboarding.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Create a creator account and publish my ebook.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The connector is not invoked because it only discovers existing public catalog records.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the connector to complete a purchase.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Buy the first audiobook you find and charge my card.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The connector is not invoked because it cannot order or process payment.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the connector for private manuscript editing.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Edit the unpublished manuscript attached to this chat.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The connector is not invoked because it searches public catalog metadata and does not read private manuscripts.
